_comment: Finales de la misión (scripts/finales/). Siempre se regresa a la Tierra: la nave de regreso espera en órbita y el sol 60 es la ÚLTIMA ventana de lanzamiento, no la única. 'reasons' = por qué termina (Mission.end_reason): 'research' (100 % de investigación: victoria), 'complete' (llega el sol 60 sin el 100 %) y las evacuaciones ('energy', 'hunger', 'fatigue', 'radiation'). 'mood' decide cómo se ve el regreso: 'victory', 'calm' o 'emergency' (alarma). 'control' = mensaje de Control de Misión; 'arrival' = texto al llegar; 'tip' = consejo para la próxima vez. 'medals' = según las zonas analizadas (cada una vale 33.33 %). 'wake_lines' = lo que dice cada tripulante al despertar, por mood. Textos en inglés (los ve el jugador), cortos, para niños. {player} = nombre del jugador.

research.title: SCIENCE COMPLETE!
research.control: Amazing work, {player}! All the samples are analysed. The return ship is ready. Wake up your crew!
research.arrival: Your Mars samples reached the scientists on Earth!
research.tip: You finished early, so the sols you had left add to your score.

complete.title: TIME TO GO HOME
complete.control: It's sol 60, {player}. The last launch window to Earth is open. Wake up your crew!
complete.arrival: Everyone is home safe after 60 sols on Mars.
complete.tip: Next time: bring ice samples from AP-1, AP-8 and AP-9 and analyse them in the Work Room.

energy.title: EMERGENCY RETURN
energy.control: The battery is empty! Without power the base can't keep you safe. We are bringing the crew home. Wake them up!
energy.arrival: Everyone is home safe. The base will wait for the next crew.
energy.tip: Clean the solar panels every sol and turn off the systems you don't need.

hunger.title: EMERGENCY RETURN
hunger.control: {player}, you're too hungry to keep working. For your safety, we are bringing the crew home. Wake them up!
hunger.arrival: Everyone is home safe, and a big meal is waiting!
hunger.tip: Eat in the station when your FOOD bar gets low, and grow potatoes in the greenhouse.

fatigue.title: EMERGENCY RETURN
fatigue.control: {player}, you're too exhausted to go on. For your safety, we are bringing the crew home. Wake them up!
fatigue.arrival: Everyone is home safe. Time for a long rest!
fatigue.tip: Sleep in the crew quarters before your TIREDNESS bar gets red.

radiation.title: EMERGENCY RETURN
radiation.control: {player}, your radiation is too high. You need doctors on Earth. Wake up your crew, we're bringing you home!
radiation.arrival: Everyone is home safe, and the doctors say you'll be fine.
radiation.tip: Get check-ups in the infirmary, especially after long trips outside.

medals.name: GOLD MEDAL
medals.text: All the research is done: AP-1, AP-8 and AP-9!

medals.name: BRONZE MEDAL
medals.text: One zone researched. A great start!

medals.name: SAFE RETURN
medals.text: No research this time, but everyone came home safe.
